english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a loud, high-pitched human scream of fear, excitement, horror, or anger.

examples.english: A scream suddenly came from next door and scared me awake.
examples.traditional: 隔離屋突然傳來一陣尖叫聲，嚇到我即刻醒晒。
